name: Crew Risk
shortDescription: Evaluates websites for crawling compliance and safety by analyzing robots.txt files, detecting anti-crawling mechanisms, identifying sensitive data, checking copyright restrictions, and scanning for exposed endpoints to provide three-tier risk ratings with specific recommendations for compliant web scraping strategies.
